prompt:
Repaint the FIRST attached image into a finished illustrated 2D game sprite sheet. First image is the exact structural 4x4 pose/layout guide generated from a real human skinned skeleton; SECOND image is the adult warrior appearance design. Produce ONLY a square transparent 4-column x 4-row sheet with EXACTLY 16 whole-body warriors, one per equal cell. Preserve first image's cell positions, character scale, foot registration, 3.5-head compact proportions, facing screen RIGHT 3/4 camera, and the sequence of arm/hammer poses. All 16 cells must be individually usable animation frames of ONE SAME PERSON, wearing ONE SAME COSTUME. Do not copy the static tall proportions of the second image; adapt that armor and mature face onto the compact human proportions of the FIRST. Each cell has ample transparent margin; no limbs, hair or hammer cross cell boundary. Keep baseline near87.5% cell height; head/torso about same location across frames, no per-frame zoom or floating feet. Exact equal rows and columns across WHOLE canvas, no gutters, text or borders.

Art direction from SECOND: adult man age40, square mature face, full nose, small sharp eyes, swept dark hair with silver forelock, short dark beard; BLUE GRAY fitted armor with COPPER bevels and rivets, BURGUNDY neck scarf and short cape tail, ivory cloth at elbows, brown leather belt, layered armored skirt, trousers and boots. Restrained surface detail. Hand-painted cartoon game art with expressive tapered dark colored outlines, 3 clear painted shading values, clean readable silhouette, not 3D plastic. Strong shoulders and full human limbs, visible anatomically sensible elbows and knees. One matching rectangular steel-and-copper fortress hammer in anatomical RIGHT hand throughout. Never swap hands. Left hand always complete, fingers relaxed/guard. Proper leather-gloved fingers firmly ENCIRCLE hammer handle with thumb opposing fingers; the handle must emerge from the closed grip rather than float beside palm. Distinct hammer rectangular head silhouette and wood grip identical across frames; preserve it under perspective/rotation.

POSE ORDER IS CRITICAL, reading left-to-right each row:
ROW1 columns1-4: IDLE breathing cycle, identical planted stance with very subtle chest/scarf movement and slight arm settle; maintain head/face size, no walking.
ROW2: attack REST; WINDUP with hammer behind right shoulder and body twist; RAISED hammer above right shoulder, right elbow bent; FORWARD OVERHEAD SWING as hammer approaches downward strike.
ROW3: IMPACT down/forward at waist height with torso lean, free arm counterbalancing; FOLLOW THROUGH with hammer low by front shin; RECOVER raising hammer toward ready; SETTLE back to same idle silhouette.
ROW4: defensive preparation; guarded raised right hammer and left forearm forward; brace/recoil with bent knees and firm feet; ease back toward guard. Defend with braced forearm/weapon, no shield added.

Use exact row1/row2/row3/row4 distribution from guide; all 16 figures present, anatomically human, face and armor consistent, sharp graphics at small game size. Model/guide bare head is not final identity; draw the designed mature hair/beard. Real transparent alpha background throughout, NO black painted background, no floor, no checkerboard, no labels, no reference figures, no speed streaks or effects. Output highest resolution square image, 2048x2048 if possible.
visual_notes: 16 poses illustrate clear human warrior, windup/impact/recovery visible.
